notes: Alert notifications and escalation (SPEC §4.7, F-ALR-4, §8.5; erratum G16). Hours are counted from when the alert opened; editable by the IT admin (P11).

escalation.chain: An alert first reaches the lowest level that has someone covering the source (village, parish, sub-county, district, region, national). Each step reaches the next level up that has someone, skipping empty levels; the chain ends at national.
escalation.timing: Step n is due escalation_hours[n-1] after the alert opened; past the list, the last gap repeats (48, 96, 144 h...).
escalation.last_resort: The IT admins are told only when nobody covers the source.
